hints.content:
Let's find the constant  of proportionality.   

In the proportional relationship between $j$ and $m$, one constant of proportionality is the number we multiply by $j$ to get $m$.

$j\, \times\,  ?=m$

$j$ | $m$ | Relationship 
:-: | :-: | :-:
$4$ | $3$ | ${4}\times\blueD{0.75}=3$
$12$ | $9$ | ${12}\times\blueD{0.75}=9$
$20$ | $15$ |  ${20}\times\blueD{0.75}=15$

The constant of proportionality is $\blueD{0.75}$.  This means we can multiply $\blueD{0.75}$ by $j$ to get $m$.

Now, let's represent that as an equation.  

$\begin{align}
{m}&=\blueD{\text{constant of proportionality}}\times{j} \\\\
{m}&=\blueD{0.75}j
\end{align}$
